engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Electronic Steering Column Lock not working
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Electronic Ignition Lock (D9) faulty
Electronic Steering Column Lock Kontrol Modülü (J764) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Electronic Ignition Lock (D9)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Electronic Steering Column Lock Kontrol Modülü (J764)
technicalNotes: Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3C), the Electronic Steering Column Lock Kontrol Modülü (J764) can be replaced individually without the entire Steering Column need to be replaced as well. Kontrol edin:  erWin for latest TPI/TSBs on this Subject.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
